note: Literature debates whether BRD4 pathogenesis in CdLS-like phenotypes operates via haploinsufficiency or distinct mutation-specific mechanisms across 19p deletions and intragenic variants.

evidence.text: Alesi et al. report that patients harboring 19p interstitial deletions share physical features with BRD4 point mutation carriers, delineating 19p13.12p13.11 deletions and reviewing genotype-phenotype correlations regarding BRD4 haploinsufficiency.

source.title: Confirmation of BRD4 haploinsufficiency role in Cornelia de Lange–like phenotype and delineation of a 19p13.12p13.11 gene contiguous syndrome
source.quote: Patients harboring a 19p interstitial deletion shared some physical features with BRD4 mutation carriers, which results in a more complex phenotype because of the involvement of several neighboring genes.

evidence.text: Culjat et al. indicate that haploinsufficiency of BRD4, either from larger 19p deletions or single gene mutations, is considered the pathogenic mechanism in CdLS-like presentations.

source.title: Perinatal findings in a patient with a novel large chromosome 19p deletion
source.quote: haploinsufficiency of BRD4, either as part of a larger deletion or as a single gene mutation, is the likely genetic mechanism of Cornelia de Lange (CdL)- like syndrome
